name: FND_FILE_UPLOAD_TRACKERS
description: This table tracks the state of files being uploaded for Attachments using a background process, which is separate from the primary process used by the User Interface.

columns.name: UPLOAD_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier for a File Upload that is being tracked by this table.

columns.name: TRACKER_ID
columns.description: Public Identifier used to synchronize the upload of the file and the attachment it is associated with.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier in the FND_DOCUMENTS table generated from the creation of a new Attachment record.

columns.name: FILE_NAME
columns.description: Name of the File that is being uploaded.

columns.name: FILE_SIZE
columns.description: Size of the file, in bytes, of the file that is being uploaded.

columns.name: MIME_TYPE
columns.description: Type of the file being uploaded, using the MIME type assigned.

columns.name: LANGUAGES
columns.description: Language codes associated with the file being uploaded.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: The state of the file being uploaded.

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: Describes the reason for the error to the end user.

columns.name: ERROR_ACTION
columns.description: Describes the action the end user needs to take to resolve the error.

columns.name: DM_REPOSITORY
columns.description: Name of the Content Server connection that received the file upload.

columns.name: DM_DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: Document Identifier assigned to the file by the Content Server.

columns.name: DM_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Version Number assigned to the file by the Content Server.

columns.name: RECENT_ITEM_ID
columns.description: Navigation information for the page and record that initiated the upload.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_BUCKET
columns.description: Name of the bucket that stores the file in the Object Store.

columns.name: OBJECT_NAME
columns.description: Name of the file in the Object Store.

columns.name: CEC_PARENT_ID
columns.description: The identifier of the parent folder of the file in Oracle Content and Experience Cloud.

columns.name: CEC_FILE_ID
columns.description: The identifier of the file in Oracle Content and Experience Cloud.

columns.name: UPLOAD_METADATA
columns.description: Additional custom information required as part of an upload for a specific repository

columns.name: SOURCE_CONTENT_TYPE
columns.description: Original MIME type of the file being uploaded.
